info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Card Terminal Operation Status API
info.description: The Card Terminal Operation Status API provides real-time updates on the status of card terminal operations within the banking channel. This API enables businesses to monitor and manage card transaction activities efficiently. Typical consumers include banking institutions and payment service providers that require quick access to terminal status information for operational oversight or troubleshooting. With this API, users can ensure smoother transaction processing and enhanced customer service.

get.summary: Fetch the current status of the card terminal operation.
get.description: This endpoint retrieves the latest status of a specific card terminal operation, allowing developers to monitor its state effectively. Utilize this to ensure seamless transactions and operational alerts.

requestBody.description: This request body retrieves the current status of the card terminal operation specific to the channel. It is essential to include all necessary parameters to ensure an accurate response.

200.description: Request completed successfully and status returned.

GetCardTerminalOperationStatusRequest.title: Card Terminal Operation Status Request Body
GetCardTerminalOperationStatusRequest.description: A string representing the operation status for a card terminal specific to a channel.
